"""Control: same live solution, with catalog endpoint anchors removed."""
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import sys

REPO = Path(r"C:\dev\moira-small-body-apsides")
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "anchored-asteroid-authority-probe-v2"
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO))
from scripts import build_unified_asteroid_catalog as horizons
from scripts.build_apsidal_passages_fixture import _authority_metadata

fixture = json.loads((REPO / "tests/fixtures/horizons_apsidal_passages_reference_2026_09_28.json").read_bytes())
controls = []
for record in fixture["records"]:
    if record["body"] not in {"Eros", "Chiron", "Sedna", "Eris"}:
        continue
    expected = record["events"][0]
    epoch = expected["epoch_tdb"]
    target = record["body_naif_id"]
    raw = horizons._fetch_tlist_raw(f"{target - 2000000};", [epoch])
    returned, columns = horizons._parse_vectors(raw)
    assert len(returned) == 1 and abs(returned[0] - epoch) <= 5e-9
    state = [column[0] for column in columns]
    radius = math.sqrt(sum(v*v for v in state[:3]))
    raw_bytes = raw.encode("utf-8")
    name = f"{target}-unanchored-control.horizons.txt"
    (OUT / name).write_bytes(raw_bytes)
    result = {"body": record["body"], "epoch_tdb": returned[0],
        "coordinate_contract": "geometric ICRF km/s; Sun center; exact TDB",
        "query_epochs_jd_tdb": [epoch],
        "authority": _authority_metadata(raw),
        "historical_distance_delta_km": radius - expected["distance_au"] * 149597870.7,
        "raw_response": name, "response_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw_bytes).hexdigest()}
    controls.append(result)
    print(json.dumps(result), flush=True)
with (OUT / "unanchored-controls.json").open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
    json.dump(controls, stream, indent=2)
    stream.write("\n")
